title: Compose the Series Markdown parameter widget
prompt: Publish "Rates Watch Data" at http://localhost:7803 serving a single widgets.json entry with these requirements: `series_markdown`: name "Series Markdown", description "Rates note for the selected time series.", endpoint /series-markdown, type markdown, sized w=12 h=8 on the grid, runButton true, params required: series — a dropdown (type endpoint), labeled "Series", options fetched from /series-options, default "DGS10"; it caches results for 15 minutes. Time-based config converts to milliseconds: "cache results for N minutes" means staleTime N*60000; "auto-refresh every N seconds" means refetchInterval N*1000..

series_markdown.name: Series Markdown
series_markdown.description: Rates note for the selected time series.

novelty: Unique params/t2 building exercise using get_workspace_snapshot, manage_backends with checks repeated_snapshots, too_many_invalid_calls, widget_def on custom:Rates Watch Data; artifact widgetdefs:Rates Watch Data/series_markdown.
